name: Genesys Works Jacksonville
what_you_do: You get 8 weeks of business and tech skills training. Then you do a paid internship for a year at a partner company, with college and career coaching.
who_can_apply: High school seniors at schools that partner with Genesys Works. The page says the Jacksonville program works with Duval County Public Schools to recruit students. The first Jacksonville class launched in 2025. The page does not state a pay rate.
pay_detail: Paid internship (rate not stated on the program pages)
duration: 8 weeks training (summer) then a year long internship
deadline_text: Dates for the next Jacksonville class were not posted on the program pages.
how_to_apply: Start on the Genesys Works application page. Choose Jacksonville. Interview. Then confirm your spot for summer training.
notes: The page says the Jacksonville program works with Duval County Public Schools to recruit students. Ask your school counselor if your school is a partner. The first Jacksonville class launched in 2025.
